reviews.title: LOCATION SELECTION AND CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text:
Honestly one of the worst experiences I’ve had using the McDonald’s app.

I placed an order to a specific location, but the app kept sending it to the wrong address for no reason. When I contacted support, instead of actually helping, the agent kept insisting that I selected the wrong location — which is simply not true.

It felt like I was being blamed for an issue caused by their own system. On top of that, I was told I’m not eligible for a refund or a corrected order because of their “terms and conditions,” which makes no sense when the mistake wasn’t from my side.

The whole experience was frustrating, unhelpful, and honestly disappointing. A brand like this should have better customer support and take responsibility when something clearly goes wrong on their end.
